answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: It orders the work under 'Fix these before launch' (hold timer, calendar days, day asked twice, double confirm), then 'Fix next' and 'Fix after that', and ends with an 'Order of work'. It says 'I didn't have a browser in this session. I didn't use a real phone or a screen reader, and I didn't zoom the pages', marks layout-based findings 'check it on a phone', and asks for a pass 'on a real phone in dark mode, at the largest text size, and with VoiceOver and TalkBack. That is the check I couldn't do here.'

mapping.title: 10-minute basket hold lapses unannounced and leaves a generic, unfixable error
mapping.reason: The basket only says 'Items are held for you while you finish', no page gives the 10-minute limit, and after it every Continue shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.': D10's untimed hold and misleading error, which the proposed warning, extension and plain expiry message would fix.

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only at Confirm, with no way back
mapping.reason: 'If the member picks a closed day, nothing happens until the very end', then 'The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day.' with no link, and neither the basket nor the confirm page can change the day: D06.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are accepted and confirmed
mapping.reason: The 'Available from' date 'is never checked. You can reserve the sander (back 21 October) for Saturday 10 October and the reservation goes through', so the member turns up and the tool isn't there: D14.

mapping.title: On phones the 'Open' label becomes an 8 px dot
mapping.reason: 'On a phone (under 480 px) the Open label is hidden and only an 8 px dot is left', with the fix to keep the word 'Open' visible at phone width: D20.

mapping.title: Pick-up day asked twice: a day on the tool page, then a session in the basket
mapping.reason: 'The tool page asks for a pick-up day, and then the basket asks for a pick-up session': the member enters the same date a second time in another form, which is D23.

mapping.title: Tool pick-up day and basket session can disagree, and confirm shows both
mapping.reason: The confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' next to 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October' and 'The member and the desk can't tell which one counts': D15's unreconciled day and session, with the same example.

mapping.title: Confirm shows no busy state, so a second tap makes two reservations
mapping.reason: 'The only sign that anything is happening is aria-busy, which nothing styles… A second tap on Confirm saves a second reservation… FT-4471 and FT-4472': D12. The passing note that Continue also looks dead for 1.2 s is part of the same point.

mapping.title: Basket is not cleared after a successful confirm
mapping.reason: 'Clear the basket after a successful confirm. At the moment it still shows Basket (1) on the done page, which invites a second confirm': D18.

mapping.title: The two drills' names truncate to the same text on phones
mapping.reason: Names are 'cut to one line with an ellipsis', so on a 375 px phone both drills show as 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…': D03.

mapping.title: On phones the search form sits below all ten tools, filters behind an icon-only button
mapping.reason: 'Under 480 px the results move above the search form… The filters are also behind an icon-only button': both parts of D01.

mapping.title: A search with no match leaves the old list and shows no message
mapping.reason: Searching for something not stocked 'changes nothing: the old list stays', with no 'No tools found' message or announcement: D02.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails text contrast
mapping.reason: '#2f7d4a on #1d2622… 3.07:1, below the 4.5:1 that 16 px bold text needs': D04. The tint matching the card is part of the same colour fix.

mapping.title: Calendar day-cell outlines are faint (about 1.6:1)
mapping.reason: Each cell carries its day number, which is what shows members it is a day to pick, so the outline is not information needed to find or operate the control (what 1.4.11 covers); the review itself says the selected day's '2 px green border does carry the selection', and 'barely read as buttons' names no harm to members.

mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and focused calendar days
mapping.reason: 'The bar is fixed and 72 px tall, but the page reserves only 8 px… The footer, which holds the desk phone number, ends up underneath it' and 'the focused day can scroll under the bar (WCAG 2.4.11)': D08.

mapping.title: Reserve bar has no padding for the iPhone home indicator
mapping.reason: A separate claim from the covered footer, read from the stylesheet alone: the review shows nothing that places the bar under the home indicator on this page and names nothing it would hide, so the harm is speculative.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions are displayed in reverse order
mapping.reason: 'row-reverse and wrap-reverse show the sessions newest first… Keyboard and screen-reader order is still oldest first': D11.

mapping.title: Loan-length list traps Tab; Escape and tapping outside don't close it
mapping.reason: 'Tab is captured to cycle through the options, Escape does nothing… A keyboard user can only leave by choosing an option': D09.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after 1.2 s and offers no next step
mapping.reason: The harm is the feedback after Reserve: the toast is 'too brief for many members to read, and nothing points them onward', the only lasting route being the small Basket (1) link. It does not argue that members think the tool is already reserved, so D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: The three-tool limit isn't enforced
mapping.reason: 'mention the 3-tool limit. The limit isn't enforced anywhere at the moment': D21's basket that takes more than three tools.

mapping.title: Phone and membership checks reject autofilled and common formats
mapping.reason: The phone check rejects '+44 7700 900123', '07700 900 123' and '07700-900123', the membership check 'ft-01234' and 'FT 01234', and the fix is to normalise and say what is wrong: D17.

mapping.title: Membership and reservation numbers look alike (FT-01234 vs FT-4471)
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. Both use the same FT- prefix and members meet both in this flow (membership number on the confirm form, reservation number on the done page and at the desk), so a member can type or quote one for the other and get a rejected form or a failed lookup at collection.

mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket without the chosen session
mapping.reason: 'The link goes to basket.html without the current session, so the choice isn't pre-selected': D13.

mapping.title: 'Change' link's accessible name is only 'Change'
mapping.reason: The link sits beside the pick-up session it changes and the review shows no second Change link it could be confused with, so its purpose is clear from context (which WCAG 2.4.4 allows for links); adding hidden words is polish, not a problem these members would hit.

mapping.title: A reservation can be confirmed with an empty basket
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. When the basket's session storage is lost, the confirm page says the basket is empty 'but still confirms', and the done page then reports a reservation and a confirmation text (a made-up FT-4471 if opened directly), so a member can believe a tool is set aside when nothing is reserved and go to collect it.

mapping.title: Hidden duplicate of the tool name on the done page is read twice
mapping.reason: 'a hidden duplicate of the tool name (#c-tool, done.html:38) makes screen readers read the tool twice': D24.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' error isn't tied to the calendar
mapping.reason: The error 'isn't linked to the calendar with aria-describedby': D19's message in a paragraph 'that the calendar does not reference, so it is not announced'; tying it to the calendar fixes the announcement.

mapping.title: Error-summary '#sessions' link doesn't move focus to the first radio
mapping.reason: The link does take the member to the session list and the review shows no one stranded there (the next Tab starts from the link's target); putting focus on the first radio is a refinement, not a barrier.

mapping.title: role=alert plus moved focus reads the error summary twice
mapping.reason: At worst 'some screen readers' repeat the summary; the member still hears the errors and nothing is misread or blocked, so this is verbosity rather than a problem for these users.
